name: S1L
about: Plan C 3.8 script S1L (C4): the save/restart/load proof. Same look and pose as S1's shots: compare mode, rts80. `load` reads the terrain files of an earlier S1 run (-ChimeraTerrainLoad=<abs dir>, e.g. T/Out/s1_a), rebuilds every chunk and re-uploads the splat; the hashes must equal that run's final hashes and the `redo` shot must match that run's `redo` shot under the local statistic (parse_terrain.py --s1l).
